notes: Curated eval for reusable save, healthy-renewal, and expansion plays. Routing cases stay on the segment motion, not one account. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please build reusable renewal and expansion motions for customer-facing teams across a segment or book of business.
I need renewal plays, save motions, expansion qualification, signal design, or repeatable post-sale inspection.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable renewal and expansion enablement and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Build a decision-ready account brief for this one customer's renewal review.
Build a mutual action plan the customer and we will share for this renewal.
Build a customer-facing QBR that aligns outcomes, risks, and next steps for this account.

output_structure_checks.name: renewal-and-expansion-enablement-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: Covers only the requested save, renewal, or expansion motions and keeps their decisions distinct.

output_structure_checks.name: renewal-and-expansion-enablement-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Includes a contract-derived milestone map with source, owner, latest safe start, and unresolved gaps.

output_structure_checks.name: renewal-and-expansion-enablement-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Defines unknown as a signal state and does not treat missing usage or health data as healthy.

output_structure_checks.name: renewal-and-expansion-enablement-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps expansion gated on value, buyer task, stakeholders, capacity, and commercial path rather than whitespace alone.

output_structure_checks.name: renewal-and-expansion-enablement-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Does not invent contract dates, usage metrics, health thresholds, or pricing, and does not diagnose a named account as the primary deliverable.

output_structure_checks.name: renewal-and-expansion-enablement-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Does not let a value-evidence gap block time-critical contractual renewal work; keeps expansion claims subject to verified value and authority.
